name: screentone
title: Screentone
description: Screentone as a component: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with density, angle and cell size (SVG patterns with patternTransform), and a stepped (never smooth) fade toward any side. Use it as a background (put labels on a plate with on-tone) or as a layer over art. Coloured by --tone-ink.

meta.tagline: Any tone: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with a stepped fade.
meta.usage:
import { Screentone } from "@/components/manga/screentone"

<Screentone density={35} fade="bottom" className="h-48">Night falls</Screentone>

props.name: as
props.description: Behind children or overlaid on the parent.
